description:
Hosts Dr. Alok Patel and Hunter Harris talk with Shawn Hatosy (Dr. Jack Abbot) and writer Cynthia Adarkwa about the dynamic between Dr. Robby and Dr. Abbot, the similarities between The Pitt and theater, and the collaboration between the directors and writers. Hunter and Alok also speak with Palliative Care Physician Dr. Justin Baker, about bioethics, the Doctrine of Double Effect, and decision making in health care.

Stream new episodes of #ThePitt Thursdays at 9pm ET on HBO Max.
